title: Turkey Study Visa Pakistan — Requirements, Fees, IELTS & FAQ | SK Immigration
description: Turkey study visa from Pakistan (Turkey): requirements, documents, fees, IELTS, low marks, timeline and FAQ. SK Immigration Services, Rawalpindi.

faqs.question: What are Turkey study visa requirements from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: University acceptance; Passport and student visa application; Funds / tuition evidence; Academic documents. SK Immigration builds a full checklist for your case.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to study in Turkey from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Budget tuition + living + visa/insurance. Turkey is generally more affordable than UK/Canada for many programmes. SK packages from PKR 50,000 cover preparation only — not tuition.

faqs.question: Do I need IELTS for Turkey study visa?
faqs.answer: English programmes may need IELTS or university English exam; Turkish programmes need Turkish proficiency.

faqs.question: Can I study in Turkey with low marks?
faqs.answer: Many flexible options — still verify recognition for your career.

faqs.question: How long does Turkey student visa take from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Often 1–4 months after admission, pathway dependent.

faqs.question: What documents are needed for Turkey student visa?
faqs.answer: Passport; Acceptance; Academics; Funds; Insurance; Photos.

faqs.question: Can I work while studying in Turkey?
faqs.answer: Student work rules differ — confirm legally before working.

faqs.question: How to apply for Turkey study visa from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Secure admission, prepare funds/insurance/docs, then file the correct national/student visa. SK Immigration sequences the file; authorities decide.

faqs.question: What is SK Immigration’s fee for Turkey study?
faqs.answer: Student packages from PKR 50,000 for preparation. Embassy and university fees are separate. No visa guarantees.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee Turkey student visa approval?
faqs.answer: No. Embassies and immigration authorities decide. We prepare complete, honest files.
